basic_info.description: Premium Bernal Heights location: Two blocks to all the best Cortland Ave shopping and dining. This 738 sqft sunny 2-bedroom is only $625,000. The hardwood floors were just refinished. I have two ready to sell if you need two identical units at the same price. This unit includes a large storage room below. It has a shared yard and a shared, new, full-size side-by-side washer and dryer below. HOA dues are only $350.
